name: Violla Georgie
bio:
Violla Georgie is an Indonesian actress and multi-disciplinary artist who began her career in theater at the age of eight. She holds a Cum Laude Bachelor of Communications degree.

On screen, Violla has appeared in films and series across diverse genres, including Joko Anwar’s Nightmares and Daydreams (Come and See Pictures), Malam Bercerita (Studio Antelope), Hubungi Agen Gue (Miles Productions), Anak Garuda, and Darah Nyai.

Her talent and professionalism reflect a deep commitment to bringing authenticity to every role, making her a trusted collaborator across projects of various scales and genres. She has been recognized both nationally and internationally: in 2021, she received a Maya Award nomination for Best New Actress for her role in Anak Garuda, and in 2024, she won Best Supporting Actress at the Kinosuites International Awards for the short film Jakarta.

Beyond acting, Violla is a versatile artist—she writes bilingual poetry, paints, practices martial arts, and plays the violin. She is also the founder of @thesketchoflife, an independent art gallery dedicated to exploring and sharing her creative vision.
